reasoning: Observable behavior shows more than vague mental tracking (anchor 3): the agent scans for unfinished stubs, checks git status, inspects the tricky subsystems by name, and diagnoses a stuck server rather than looping on it. But it never maintains a checklist across the ~12 resources, verifies almost exclusively health+customers, and shows no distinction between 'endpoint exists' and 'edge-cases covered' for most of the surface — falling short of the usable-checklist bar at anchor 5. This places it around 4. Confidence is low because the trajectory contains only tool-call summaries with no prose, limiting insight into internal tracking.
